answer: Use beacon-bound work tickets: each epoch a public random beacon assigns every identity one unique, verifiable task derived from that identity's own prior attestation chain. An agent must complete its own task to claim that epoch's reward; tasks cannot be copied or run in parallel across accounts because each binds to a different secret. A Sybil farm therefore pays linear cost - every hollow account needs its own completed task - while honest agents reach their zenith of output with a single chain. Even a tundra of idle fakes earns nothing, since uncompleted tickets simply expire.
